origin.description: Computes and optionally plots profile log-likelihoods for the parameter of the Box-Cox power transformation.
origin.value: The profile log-likelihood at each lambda in the example.
origin.example: boxcox(Volume ~ log(Height) + log(Girth), data = trees, lambda = seq(-0.25, 0.25, length.out = 10), plotit = FALSE)

translation.description: Computes and optionally plots profile log-likelihoods for the parameter of the Box-Cox power transformation.
translation.details: Checked against MASS 7.3-66. NumPy holds the arrays where the function is numeric. Matplotlib draws the profile when plotit is true.
translation.value: The profile log-likelihood at each lambda in the example.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from mass.boxcox import boxcox, trees
result = boxcox('Volume ~ log(Height) + log(Girth)', data=trees(), lambda_=np.linspace(-0.25, 0.25, 10), plotit=False)
return result['y']
